name: pr-agent
description: Agent skills for running PR-Agent reviews and descriptions from the CLI or a local branch, adding it as a GitHub Action, and configuring it with .pr_agent.toml.

interface.longDescription: Skills for PR-Agent, the open-source AI pull request reviewer. Covers running describe, review, improve, ask and other commands via Docker, pip or uv against GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea or Azure DevOps PRs, saving a review to a file instead of publishing, and reviewing a local branch with the local git provider; adding the GitHub Action with the right permissions, secrets and triggers (and the pull_request_target trade-off for forks); and configuring behaviour with .pr_agent.toml, environment variables and host-controlled settings.
defaultPrompt: Review my current branch against main with PR-Agent
Add the PR-Agent GitHub Action to this repo
Tune .pr_agent.toml so reviews focus on security
